info.title: Maneyindha Marukatte API
info.description: Localized marketplace for home-based women entrepreneurs. All responses use the envelope `{success, data, meta?}` or `{success:false, error:{message, code?, retryAfterSeconds?}}`. Money amounts in orders are rupees; Razorpay amounts are paise. Secrets are never returned by any endpoint.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access JWT (15 min). Obtain via POST /auth/otp/verify; renew with POST /auth/refresh.

RazorpayCheckout.description: Everything the browser needs to open Razorpay Checkout. Contains the PUBLIC key id only.

post.summary: Rotate token pair using refresh token
Exchange Firebase ID token (phone OTP / Google / Apple) for backend JWT pair

get.summary: Geo search for approved businesses

parameters.name: minRating
parameters.description: Only shops with at least one review and an average ≥ this

parameters.name: hasVideo
parameters.description: Only shops with a promo video

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Omit for nearest first. Otherwise shops within radiusKm ordered by this; distanceKm is still returned.

get.description: Searches the coarsened public point. Each result carries `distanceKm` (0.1 km resolution, from the coarse point). Shops that have not shared a location are not returned here (they still appear in GET /businesses).

List approved shops (coarsened public location)

parameters.name: minRating

get.description: Approved shops only. Public shape: no documents, no exact location.

get.summary: Search/list products

post.description: Only for an APPROVED shop (403 BUSINESS_NOT_APPROVED otherwise).

get.summary: Product details

delete.summary: Remove one of your products (entrepreneur, owner only)

paymentMethod.description: razorpay: order is created unpaid; call POST /payments/razorpay/order next. The shop cannot confirm it until payment is confirmed by the server.

get.summary: Orders received by the shops I own (entrepreneur only; customer name and phone included)
Orders I placed (as a customer)
Get my cart with computed totals

post.summary: Apply coupon (validated: window, business, min amount, usage limits)
Create review; orderId makes it a verified purchase (must be delivered)
post.description: Ratings come only from real buyers: `orderId` is required and must be a DELIVERED order of yours containing the product; you cannot rate your own products.

get.summary: List reviews for a product
Get wishlist (products + followed shops)

post.summary: Submit the application for review (status → in_review) (needs ID proof, business proof and a business profile photo; PHOTO_MISSING otherwise)
post.description: No body. Requires an ID proof and a business proof to have been uploaded through `POST /businesses/{id}/documents`. Any URLs sent in the body are ignored.

422.description: Required documents missing (DOCUMENTS_MISSING) or already submitted

get.summary: List verification requests by status

post.description: Approve only works on an application that has been submitted (in_review) with ID proof and business proof on file; otherwise 422 NOT_SUBMITTED / DOCUMENTS_MISSING.

get.summary: Liveness probe (served at /health, outside /api/v1)

429.description: Cooldown or rate limit. See Retry-After header / error.retryAfterSeconds

502.description: Email provider rejected or failed (code: EMAIL_SEND_FAILED)

post.description: Generates a 6-digit code (CSPRNG), stores only a keyed hash, and emails it. 5-minute expiry; 60-second resend cooldown; a new code invalidates older ones; per-IP and per-email limits. The code is NEVER returned in the response.

post.summary: Verify the emailed code and sign in
post.description: Single use. 5 wrong attempts burn the code. Creates the account on first successful verification. Returns access + refresh tokens bound to a revocable session.

post.summary: Revoke the session for a refresh token
post.description: Idempotent. Access tokens already issued remain valid until they expire (≤15 min).

post.summary: Revoke every session of the signed-in user

get.summary: Current user

patch.description: avatarUrl cannot be set here; use POST /users/me/avatar. Address coordinates are optional (manual entry) and validated when present.

post.description: multipart/form-data, field `avatar`. JPEG/PNG/WebP decided by file content (not the declared type), ≤ 2 MB, 20 uploads/hour. Stored on Cloudinary; one stable object per user.

delete.summary: Remove profile photo (back to the default avatar)

post.summary: Switch customer <-> entrepreneur; returns fresh tokens
Create (or reuse) the Razorpay order for one of your own pending orders

422.description: Not an online-payment order / no longer payable

post.description: Amount is computed from the stored order total (rupees × 100 → paise); any amount in the request is ignored. Idempotent: repeating returns the same Razorpay order. Test/sandbox keys only until you go live.

Recomputes HMAC-SHA256(razorpay_order_id|razorpay_payment_id) with the key secret using the order id stored server-side, compares in constant time, then fetches the payment from Razorpay and checks status=captured, order id, amount and currency before marking the order paid. The browser callback alone never marks anything paid.

get.summary: Backend payment status for one of your orders (the UI shows this, nothing else)

post.description: Not for browsers. Authenticated by the X-Razorpay-Signature header = HMAC-SHA256(raw body, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET); the body is read raw before JSON parsing. Deduplicated on X-Razorpay-Event-Id. Handles payment.captured, order.paid, payment.failed; other events are acknowledged and ignored. Amount and currency are re-checked against the order.

502.description: Provider failed or returned unusable output (AI_PROVIDER_ERROR / AI_BAD_OUTPUT)

post.description: Provider-backed (AI_PROVIDER=gemini|openai). Only the product name/category/details are sent to the provider. Output is schema-validated (20–600 chars) and sanitised; a draft for the seller to review. 30 requests/hour/user.

get.summary: Where the app can be opened/downloaded, as configured by the operator
get.description: Returns {configured:false} when no valid public https destination is configured. Store links are reported "as configured"; the server does not check that a listing exists.

get.summary: QR code (PNG) for the configured destination

patch.summary: Set the shop's exact location (owner only)
patch.description: Exact point is visible to the owner/admins only; public responses carry a coarsened (~110 m) point and a distance computed from it.

get.summary: Shops owned by the signed-in entrepreneur (exact location included)
Stock photo suggestions (Pexels when configured, placeholders otherwise)
Reviews for a shop
List my verification documents (metadata only)

post.description: multipart/form-data: `file` plus `type` (id_proof | business_proof | address_proof | other) and, for id_proof, `identityType` (Aadhaar | Voter ID | Driving License | Passport). PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP decided by file content, ≤ 5 MB, 40 uploads/hour. Stored as a private (authenticated) asset, never as a public URL. One document per type: re-uploading replaces it. Only while the application is pending or rejected.

422.description: Missing/invalid fields, or application is locked

delete.summary: Remove one of my verification documents

get.summary: Short-lived (5 min) signed link to one verification document

200.description: { url, expiresInSeconds, mime, type } — Cache-Control: no-store

post.summary: Administrator sign-in (the only way to become admin)
post.description: Credentials come from server configuration (`ADMIN_USERNAME` and a salted scrypt `ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH` made with `npm run admin:hash`); there is no sign-up, OTP or profile call that can create an admin. Signing in demotes any other account that carries an admin role.

409.description: ADMIN_USERNAME is held by a normal member

429.description: Too many attempts (10 per 15 min per IP)

get.summary: Average, count and 1–5 star spread for an approved shop

post.summary: Get a signed Cloudinary upload for this shop's promo video
post.description: Owner only, approved shops only. The browser uploads the video straight to Cloudinary (videos are too large for a serverless request), sending exactly `fields` plus `file`. 20 requests/hour. The API secret never leaves the server.

post.summary: Register an uploaded promo video after checking it
post.description: The server asks Cloudinary about the upload and accepts only MP4/MOV/WebM, ≤ 100 MB, ≤ 60 s, under this shop's own folder. Replaces and deletes the previous video.

422.description: VIDEO_INVALID (format, > 100 MB or > 60 s — the upload is deleted) or foreign publicId

get.summary: Items from my delivered orders that I have not rated yet
My badge, progress and reward coupons
get.description: Badge tiers come from DELIVERED orders (New Member 0, Explorer 1, Regular 3, Loyal Patron 6, Champion 12). Reward coupons: WELCOME10 (new customers), REGULAR5, LOYAL10, CHAMPION100 — each once per customer, unlocked by badge, and enforced again at checkout.

get.summary: Platform statistics (admin only)
get.description: Computed live from the database. Revenue = what customers paid for delivered orders (gross); the platform takes no commission today.

200.description: users, shops, orders, reviews, coupons, 14-day series

get.summary: Members list (admin only, read-only)
My notifications (latest 50) and the unread count

post.summary: Mark my notifications read (body ids optional; none = all)

patch.summary: Suspend (reason required) or restore one shop; the owner is notified in the app and by email

get.summary: Shop owners with shops, delivered orders, revenue, rating and badge (read-only)
One owner: details, badges, shops and six months of growth
All shops with owner, status, suspension, products, orders and revenue (?status=approved|in_review|pending|rejected|suspended)
All products with shop, price and stock
Entrepreneur badge distribution, achievements and leaderboard
Monthly growth of members, shops and orders, with month-on-month change (?months=3..12)

patch.summary: Suspend (reason required) or restore a member; signs them out and hides their shops when suspended; they are notified in the app and by email

delete.summary: Take down a shop's promo video

post.summary: Customer help assistant (real AI provider only)
post.description: Answers from app facts, public catalogue matches and, when the question is about orders, the caller's own order statuses. Recommended products/shops are limited to ones actually present in that data. No name, email, phone, address or payment data is sent to the provider.

503.description: AI_NOT_CONFIGURED — there is no canned fallback

post.summary: Upload a product photo from the seller's gallery
post.description: Entrepreneurs only. multipart/form-data with one `photo` file (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 3 MB; type is checked from the bytes). Returns an https URL to send in `images` when creating the product. 60 requests/hour.

200.description: Uploaded; data.url is the photo URL

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image

get.summary: Featured shop videos for the home banner (best-rated first, at most 3)
get.description: Public. Shops with an approved, playable video, ranked by a review-count-weighted rating (so one lucky 5-star review does not beat an established shop); ties go to more reviews; unrated shops come last and have rating null. `limit` 1-3 (default 3). Cached for 60 seconds.

get.summary: Shop videos waiting for (or past) review
get.description: Admin only. Default status is pending.

200.description: Queue of shops with their video

post.summary: Approve or reject a shop's video
post.description: Admin only. `action` approve or reject; reject needs a short `reason` which the owner sees.

get.summary: The entrepreneur's badge, progress and achievements
get.description: Entrepreneurs only. Badge tiers come from orders their shops have delivered; achievements: Highly Rated (4.5 stars or more from 5+ reviews) and On Camera (an approved shop video). Customers do not get badges; they get coupons from /rewards/me.

post.description: Owner only. multipart/form-data with one `photo` file (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 3 MB, type checked from the bytes). Stored as the shop cover (`bannerUrl`); a new upload replaces the old one. 30 requests/hour.
